g.text: NOTT Plugin: 17 Task Routes, System1 Hooks & Multi-Client Views
CONTRACT SPEC • CLOSED-LOOP LIFECYCLE • CROSS-CLIENT NATIVE VIEWS • D18 GATE
• Devil's advocate premise testing & risk exposure

Rule: Load before action; body bytes cost session context

• Loop is the point: review holding is prerequisite to execution
• Owner accepts direction/DoD; NOTT settles technical method
Cleaning removes obsolete code before gate measures; no leftover debt
Candidate proof admits integration; installed proof closes delivery.
• Compiles SHA-256 verified custom views from canonical canon
Improvises runners, premature implementation, no test proof
Observed RED-first, D18 verdicts, independent reviewers
Strict counterfactual proof: plugin directly causes compliance
• Verifies nMEMORY bootstrap receipts before activate

Receipt proof: SHA-256 manifest + live readback
